name: a playful headline with highlighted word chips over drifting shapes
looks: On a bold flat colour field, a headline builds word by word, each key word boxed in its own solid highlight colour the instant it lands, while soft rounded squares drift slowly behind it; a second line of smaller type adds a supporting claim.
build: Each headline word fades/scales in, immediately followed by its highlight box scaling in from the left (scaleX on a colour block, 0.1-0.15 s); background squares drift on a slow seeded path with gentle rotation.
sound: A soft pop per highlighted word, a quiet ambient bed under the drifting shapes.
prompt: Build a short, punchy headline word by word on a bold flat colour field, boxing each key word in its own solid highlight colour the instant it lands. Let a few soft rounded shapes drift slowly behind the type for texture, and add a smaller supporting line beneath once the headline settles.
